app.name: Audit Report Anchoring
app.tagline: Anchor audit-report PDFs on a public testnet, and let anyone check a copy in their browser.
app.prototypeNotice: Prototype. Testnet anchors are not legal evidence.

kitchenSink.title: UI kit
kitchenSink.intro: Every component this repo copies from Inflect, rendered in this app's theme.
kitchenSink.clientHint: The UIC for a Bulgarian company.
kitchenSink.opinionDescription: Confirm the text exactly as it appears in the report.
kitchenSink.tooltipContent: A 32-byte SHA-256 value. Only commitments go on chain.
kitchenSink.emptyDescription: Upload an audit report to anchor its first version.
kitchenSink.errorDescription: The two RPC endpoints disagree, so no verdict is shown.
kitchenSink.modalBody: A second person approves every anchor before it is broadcast.
kitchenSink.confirmBody: Revocation is permanent and visible to every verifier.
kitchenSink.sheetBody: Each version names its parent, so every copy resolves to the latest.
